features.label: Lived in a jar deliberately
features.detail: Poverty as a public argument, performed for decades in the middle of a wealthy city.

features.label: Almost entirely anecdote
features.detail: What survives is stories told about him, not by him. Separating fact from legend is impossible.

features.label: Attack, not system
features.detail: He built no philosophy. He aimed himself at everyone who had one.
